description: 3 icon + label + bold value contact columns on beige band

contentPattern.structure: one row with one cell per contact method; each cell: icon image, label paragraph, bold value paragraph. Bare phone numbers become tel: links and email addresses become mailto: links
notes: Three contact items laid out side by side.

usage: Use for a support/contact band listing phone numbers and email addresses.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any row of icon + label + value items, e.g. contact channels or key facts.
